how_to_unblock.summary: Ingest the verified IFC into a SEPARATE iModel using a supported Bentley IFC connector, then point the viewer at the new iModel id.
options: OPTION A (desktop): on a Windows machine, install the iTwin Synchronizer desktop app, sign in with a Bentley account that has create+synchronize rights on the MRTway Development Twin (bdf29ecd-...), create a new iModel 'MRTway Medical Clinic Demo', add Clinic_Architectural.ifc, and run synchronization (IFC connector).

OPTION B (cloud API): use the iTwin Platform Synchronization API (developer.bentley.com/apis/synchronization) with the IFC connector — requires a service/agent client with synchronization scopes, a Storage/file container to upload the IFC, and iModel-creation permission on the iTwin.
then: capture the new DEMO_IMODEL_ID and provide it so the viewer can open it (config change VITE_BENTLEY_IMODEL_ID for the demo, keeping the fixture id separate).
how_to_unblock.then_here: Once the demo iModel id exists, this environment can open it in the existing viewer and run RUN BIM CONTENT AUDIT against it, then stop for manual screenshot acceptance.
